activities.summary: Sourced from CMA Lebanon register and fbl.com.lb. Small, 100%-family-owned (Saab family) retail bank - size and ownership structure cut both ways on viability, genuinely unclear. Resolution-track status not publicly confirmed.

description: Smaller, wholly Lebanese-owned retail bank established 1952, 9 branches, owned entirely by the founding Saab family (Ayoub Farid Michel Saab and Fadi Michel Saab). Offers commercial/trade/corporate finance, retail banking and financial-market brokerage. Listed on CMA Lebanon's approved-institutions register.

fit.reasoning: Fit: bank segment (20) + Lebanon (15) + some multi-asset via brokerage service line (10) + third-party deposits (10) + BDL/CMA regulated (5) = 60/60, though this is a small, single-market retail bank, likely lighter operational complexity than the larger names in this batch. Timing: sector-wide pressure only (10/25) - no individual viability confirmation; being small and 100% family-owned could cut either way on viability (less foreign-correspondent exposure, but also less capital buffer) - genuinely unknown. Access: two named family owners identified but no contact route or individual LinkedIn profiles found = 3/15. Total mechanically ~73, held to 42 given size uncertainty compounds the resolution-status uncertainty.
